description.zh: macOS 上自用的 DSH 插件：AOCI 认知面板与 CodeGraph 调用关系图。
description.en: DSH plugins for macOS: AOCI cognition panel and CodeGraph call graph.

description.zh: 把 AOCI 仓库认知索引做成会话标签页：索引正文浏览与搜索（841 条 F/R/A/S）、治理体检（把 443 条 code_skipped 良性发现与真正的阻塞项分开）、S 红线筛选、一键 verify / maintain、索引在线编辑与备份恢复。上游 dsh-aoci-panel 仅支持 Windows 且治理功能在 macOS 上失效（二进制探测只认 .exe、home 只读 USERPROFILE、install.ps1），本版修好平台适配并补齐能力。
description.en: Brings the AOCI repository cognition index into a conversation tab: browse and search entries (F/R/A/S), governance health check that separates benign findings from real blockers, S-constraint filter, one-click verify/maintain, and in-place index editing with backup/restore. The upstream plugin was Windows-only and its governance features degraded on macOS.

description.zh: CodeGraph 官方没有 UI（codegraph ui 仍报 coming in an upcoming release），本插件补上：索引概览（文件/节点/边/体积/语言/待同步）、符号搜索、cytoscape 交互式调用关系图（以符号为中心 1-3 跳邻域，节点按类型着色、边按 calls/imports/extends 着色）、影响面分析、符号详情（元数据 + 源码与调用链），以及一键 sync / 重建索引。图数据直读 .codegraph 的 nodes/edges 表（CLI 的 impact 只给平铺节点拿不到连线），只读打开。
description.en: CodeGraph ships no UI (codegraph ui still reports 'coming in an upcoming release'), so this plugin adds one: index overview, symbol search, an interactive cytoscape call graph with 1-3 hop neighborhoods, impact analysis, symbol details with source and call chain, and one-click sync/reindex. Graph data is read directly from the .codegraph SQLite nodes/edges tables (the CLI's impact output has no edges), always opened read-only.
